purpose: One conditional, known-history factor screen; no brokerage account or investable-profit claim
arithmetic: Source QA and ranking Decimal precision50 with an explicit fresh context; index arithmetic binary64; Python3.12 random.Random seed frozen
ranking: descending adjusted-close ratio over six complete calendar months; ticker ascending for ties
execution: Next provider trading-session close after decision; old weights earn that session return; new weights start after that close
weighting: Equal thirds at each scheduled rebalance; buy-and-hold drift between rebalances; no positive-return filter
reference: Same dates and rebalance closes, nine-asset equal weight, no transaction-cost deduction

fee_proxy.application: Multiplicative return budget deducted at every scheduled rebalance even with unchanged constituents; initial entry and final exit separately
fee_proxy.derivation: USD1000 reference, three buys/sells, minimum1 or2.50 each, slippage10 or30bps per side, sell buffer5bps

source_qa.xlf_vendor_split_representation: Only on2016-09-19, ratio strictly between1 and2, internally consistent fields; classification is vendor adjustment for an in-kind distribution, never a true share split
source_qa.event_rules: All dates inside full source sessions; no duplicate or malformed events; ordinary dividend amounts remain opaque; unknown split dates or capital-gain event types stop; known XLF special date needs a dividend or vendor split event
source_qa.scope_of_acceptance: Coarse major-action omission check only; does not certify complete corporate actions, raw share units or exact total-return accuracy
source_qa.date_sets: All nine exact ordered session sets equal; no intersection deletion, forward fill, substitution or missing month
source_qa.first_numeric_read: Only two XLF QA adjclose points; full adjusted-close decode allowed only after fixed QA passes

stop_on_failure: No parameter changes, source substitution, missing-asset deletion, interval truncation, fee relaxation or financial rerun
